thread:
maria: Heads-up — CI watchdog killed the e2e job on my PR (#9083) and the pipeline shows a snapshot diff that looks unrelated to my changes. blocking the merge for now. logs below.

maria: job log snippet:
```
[watchdog] no stdout activity for 10m, terminating process
ERROR: e2e/checkout.spec.ts › Checkout flow › should persist cart after payment
Snapshot diff: 8 additions, 2 deletions in __snapshots__/checkout.snap
(appears like ordering of line items changed)
```

akash: ugh. which test shard did it run on? looks like a race in the test rather than app change.

maria: shard 4/6. I reran locally and couldn't repro immediately — takes a couple of tries.

nina: can you paste the failing test name so i can grep?

maria: "Checkout flow › should persist cart after payment"

sam: two quick things we can try: (1) rerun only the e2e shard on CI, (2) if it keeps flaking, add a small guard to the test instead of updating snapshots.

maria: agreed. i'm not comfortable approving a snapshot update if this is nondeterministic. i'll try a small wait fix and push.

akash: also try increasing the watchdog heartbeat or timeout for that job temporarily — we had a similar hang last month when puppeteer output silenced for long network ops.

maria: buildwatcher posted the job link: https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/9083/build/2315 — thanks.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by @maria — e2e shard (4/6) queued.

maria: local repro command in case anyone else wants to try: `yarn test:e2e --grep "persist cart after payment" --shard=4/6`

nina: i'll run that shard in a container and see if i hit it. if it's timing, adding `await page.waitForResponse(r => r.url().includes('/cart') && r.status() === 200)` after checkout might stabilize things.

sam: if you add the guard, put a short comment linking the flaky issue #1124 so we can revert later if infra fixes it.

maria: pushing a tiny test change now: adds the wait and a comment, no snapshot update. i'll also include a note in the PR description.

akash: nice. once CI green, we can merge. if the watchdog still kills the job, i'll temporarily bump the timeout in the pipeline for the e2e job and open a follow-up to tune it permanently.

buildwatcher: Job re-run started (PR #9083, shard 4/6).

maria: thanks — will monitor.

buildwatcher: Job passed: e2e shard 4/6. All checks for PR #9083 are now green.

maria: merging. i'll follow up with issue #1124 to track long term flake and a note about the watchdog behavior. :tada:

sam: nice — thanks for the quick turnaround! :shipit:
